### Symbols for linear algebra

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $\mathbf v$ | vector of $\mathbb R^n$ or $\mathbb C^n$, a column vector, or a vector of physical space (bold lowercase); components $v_i$ |
| $V$, $W$, $U$ | vector spaces and subspaces; their elements $v \in V$ are plain when no basis is chosen |
| $V^*$ | dual space of $V$ |
| $\mathbf e_i$ | $i$-th standard basis vector of $\mathbb R^n$ |
| $e_i$, $e^i$ | basis of an abstract vector space and its dual basis |
| $\mathbf 0$ | zero vector |
| $\mathbf A$ | matrix (bold uppercase); entries $A_{ij}$ |
| $\mathbf A^\top$ | transpose |
| $\mathbf A^{-1}$ | inverse of a square matrix |
| $A^\dagger$ | Hermitian adjoint: conjugate transpose of a matrix, adjoint of an operator on a Hilbert space |
| $A^*$ | entrywise complex conjugate of a matrix |
| $\mathbf I$, $\mathbf I_n$ | identity matrix ($n \times n$) |
| $1$ | identity operator on a vector space |
| $\operatorname{tr}$ | trace |
| $\operatorname{tr}_W$ | partial trace over the factor $W$ of $V \otimes W$ |
| $\det$ | determinant |
| $\operatorname{adj}\mathbf A$ | adjugate of a square matrix, $\mathbf A\operatorname{adj}\mathbf A = \det\mathbf A\,\mathbf I$ |
| $\operatorname{sgn}\sigma$ | sign of a permutation, $\pm 1$ |
| $\operatorname{Alt}$ | alternation of a multilinear map, $(\operatorname{Alt}\beta)(v_1, \dots, v_k) = \sum_\sigma \operatorname{sgn}\sigma\, \beta(v_{\sigma(1)}, \dots, v_{\sigma(k)})$ |
| $\operatorname{rank}$ | rank |
| $\operatorname{diag}(a_1, \dots, a_n)$ | diagonal matrix with the given entries |
| $\operatorname{span}$ | linear span |
| $\ker$ | kernel (null space) |
| $\operatorname{proj}_U$ | orthogonal projection onto a subspace $U$ |
| $\otimes$ | tensor product of vectors and spaces; $S \otimes T$ for linear maps, $(S \otimes T)(v \otimes w) = Sv \otimes Tw$ |
| $\oplus$ | direct sum |
| $\wedge$ | wedge (exterior) product |
| $\odot$ | entrywise (Hadamard) product |
| $\langle u, v\rangle$ | inner product |
| $\lvert\psi\rangle$, $\langle\psi\rvert$ | ket and bra of a Hilbert space |
| $\lVert\mathbf x\rVert$ | Euclidean norm, or the norm of the space |
| $\lVert\mathbf x\rVert_p$ | $\ell_p$ norm |
| $\lVert\mathbf A\rVert_F$ | Frobenius norm |
| $e^{\mathbf A}$, $\exp\mathbf A$ | matrix exponential $\sum_{k \geq 0}\mathbf A^k/k!$ of a square matrix |
| $\lVert\mathbf A\rVert_2$ | operator (spectral) norm |
| $\delta_{ij}$, $\delta^i{}_j$ | Kronecker delta |
| $\epsilon_{ijk}$ | Levi-Civita symbol, $\epsilon_{123} = +1$ |
| $\mathbf u\cdot\mathbf v$ | dot product $\sum_i u_iv_i$ of $\mathbb R^n$ |
| $\mathbf u\times\mathbf v$ | cross product of $\mathbb R^3$, $(\mathbf u\times\mathbf v)_i = \epsilon_{ijk}u_jv_k$; $\mathbf u\cdot(\mathbf v\times\mathbf w)$ is the triple product |
| $\lambda$ | eigenvalue, $\mathbf A\mathbf v = \lambda\mathbf v$ |
| $\mathbf A = \mathbf P\mathbf D\mathbf P^\top$ | eigendecomposition of a symmetric matrix: orthogonal $\mathbf P$ of eigenvectors, diagonal $\mathbf D$ of eigenvalues |
| $\mathbf A = \mathbf U\boldsymbol\Sigma\mathbf V^\top$ | singular value decomposition: singular vectors $\mathbf u_i$, $\mathbf v_i$ and singular values $\sigma_i$ on the diagonal of $\boldsymbol\Sigma$ |
| $(p, q)$ | signature of a symmetric bilinear form: numbers of positive and negative eigenvalues |

Conventions:

- Vectors are bold, $\mathbf v$, in every tutorial, including the vectors of physical space. Bold numerals such as
  $\mathbf 3$ are labels of representations, not vectors.
- The transpose is $^\top$.
- A complex inner product is antilinear in the first slot, $\langle \lambda u, v\rangle = \lambda^*\langle u, v\rangle$;
  a real one is symmetric and bilinear, and on $\mathbb R^n$ it is $\langle\mathbf x, \mathbf y\rangle = \mathbf x^\top\mathbf y$.
- Operator names are upright: $\operatorname{tr}$, $\operatorname{rank}$, $\operatorname{diag}$, $\operatorname{span}$.
